entries.question: Three AKS Deployments consume one mutable ConfigMap that has just been updated. A reads its value from an environment variable at process startup. B reads a file mounted with subPath. The current Pods for A and B started before the update. C uses an ordinary ConfigMap volume and rereads the file per request; that file already shows the new value. Which focused rollout plan makes the updated configuration available to all three applications while keeping C running?
correctAnswerText: Roll out new Pods for A and B; leave C running.
entries.subskill: Deploy and manage applications to Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) by using manifest files
